question.text: During electrolysis of molten $\mathrm{NaCl},$ some water was added. What will happen?

options.text: Some amount of caustic soda will be formed

solution.text:
During electroysis of molten $\mathrm{NaCl}$, when water is added, the following
statements are true
(a) false
(b) $\because \mathrm{Na}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O} \longrightarrow \mathrm{NaOH}+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{H}_{2}$
and discharge potential of hydrogen is less than of sodium. So, $\mathrm{H}_{2}$ will evolve.
(c) Some amount of caustic soda (NaOH) will be formed [As shown in (b)]
(d) Fire can likely take place because relations given given in (b) is highly exothermic.
$\therefore(b),(c)$ and $(d)$ are correct.
